attempts.summary: Established a persistent AIDE integrity baseline for /etc on node1. It monitors file content, type, permissions, ownership, links, size, ACLs, SELinux labels, and extended attributes across 1,190 entries. A daily persistent timer writes the latest report to /var/log/aide/etc-integrity-report.latest. Content-change detection and clean restoration were demonstrated, and the final configuration remained healthy across reboot.
